value.workerManifest: Create exactly one worker return; no existing file modification, deletion, rename, staging, commit, runtime command, live proof or external effect.
value.successorCap: Zero by default; at most one consolidated repair candidate for current source-backed P0/P1. More than one irreducible owner/risk bundle requires fresh authority.
value.learningRoute: Evaluate one bounded TPGR owner upgrade for tranche admission/continuation marginal value across remediation, external absorption and project delivery; no parallel framework or implementation in R11.
value.proof: Pre-dispatch 79/79 and pre-commit 87/87 passed; commit hook passed 87/87; zero provider, network, external-store, credential, live, build, release, public-sync, deployment or push action occurred.
value.nextAllowedMove: Transfer the committed R11 packet to a no-commit reconciliation worker. Worker proves ancestry/state/hashes, creates one return, runs the worker-return fast gate, and yields COMPLETE_PENDING_REVIEW or BLOCKED_WITH_REASON.
value.claimBoundary: Final reconciliation dispatch only. RFR execution, runtime repair and TPGR implementation remain separately governed and parked.
